name: LangMem
ontology_notes: Library primitives, not a product ontology. Conceptual guide names semantic (profile or collection), episodic (Episode schema with observation/thoughts/action/result), and procedural (prompt rules). Default collection item is Memory(content=str). Callers pass Pydantic schemas to create_memory_manager. Namespaces are tuples such as ("memories", "{langgraph_user_id}"). Official docs llms.txt at langchain-ai.github.io/langmem/llms.txt returned 404 on 2026-09-11.

ontology.evidence: Conceptual guide Types of Memory. create_memory_manager(schemas=[UserProfile]) or Episode. Default is unstructured Memory. No built-in character vs user vs relationship tables.
ontology.label: measured

write_policy.evidence: Hot path: create_manage_memory_tool (agent create/update/delete). Background: create_memory_store_manager extracts after the turn. Instructions default to remember preferences and explicit remember requests. enable_inserts default True.
write_policy.label: measured

read_policy.evidence: create_search_memory_tool calls BaseStore.search(query, limit, offset, filter). Hot-path quickstart also embeds new messages and injects hits into the system prompt. Agent may retrieve nothing if it skips the tool.
read_policy.label: measured

supersession.evidence: manage_memory action update overwrites by id. Collection managers reconcile insert/update/delete via LLM. enable_deletes defaults to False on create_memory_store_manager (docs reference/memory). Profile mode uses enable_inserts=False so one document is updated.
supersession.label: measured

temporal.evidence: BaseStore items have created_at/updated_at in the tools example, but search is semantic plus optional metadata filter. No last-Tuesday query path in the conceptual guide or tools.py.
temporal.label: measured

identity_split.evidence: NamespaceTemplate can include {langgraph_user_id}. That is one user bag unless the app adds more namespace levels. No first-class character or relationship id.
identity_split.label: measured

silence.evidence: search_memory has no social skip. Hits are dumped into the prompt in the create_react_agent example.
silence.label: measured

poisoning.evidence: No trust tags. Extracted Memory.content is whatever the LLM writes. Prompt optimizer can change system behavior from trajectories.
poisoning.label: measured

forgetting.evidence: manage_memory action delete calls store.delete. Store manager enable_deletes defaults False so background extract will not delete unless set. No user-facing forget-that.
forgetting.label: measured

cost_shape.evidence: Hot path: tool-call LLM plus embed on search. Background manager: extra LLM extract (optional query_model) plus store upsert. Short-term summarize_messages is a separate LLM pass when tokens exceed max_tokens_before_summary.
cost_shape.label: measured

local.evidence: MIT. InMemoryStore or self-hosted Postgres BaseStore. Needs an LLM API or local model. No LangMem cloud required. LangGraph Platform store is optional.
local.label: measured

mcp.evidence: README and conceptual guide describe Python tools for LangGraph. No official MCP server in the repo root or docs index fetched.
mcp.label: measured

companion_fit_reason: You can attach a profile schema and namespaces, but the library still extracts text, stores it, and injects hits. No silence, no companion identity types, no official MCP.
open_unknowns: Whether any LangChain-hosted MCP wrapper exists outside this repo.
Default Memory Pydantic fields beyond content were not re-read from extraction.py after GitHub search rate-limit.
